title: Sri Lanka Family Vacation | Free Turtle Hatchery Visit
highlights: Discover Sri Lanka's diverse landscapes, from lush rainforests and tea plantations to pristine beaches and serene lakes.
Explore the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic in Kandy, a UNESCO World Heritage Site housing Buddha’s sacred tooth.
Visit the Kosgoda Turtle Hatchery, where you can learn about turtle conservation, witness baby turtles, and even help release them into the ocean.
Explore the Gangaramaya Temple in Colombo, a unique blend of traditional and modern architecture, housing ancient relics and stunning sculptures.
Shop at the Pettah Floating Market in Colombo, a one-of-a-kind shopping spot with stalls on boats offering local goods, handmade crafts, and a charming waterside ambiance.
overview:
About the Tour:
Endowed with a diverse collection of landscapes, climates, natural features and infamous beaches Sri Lanka has been enticing visitors for many years. Offering a myriad range of fun, adventure, and romance, it is among the best destinations in the world for those looking for an exotic vacation. Right from beaches, hills, jungles, ancient monuments, culture, history to nightlife, wildlife, and excellent food a blend of all these is what makes the soul-satisfying everything make it a paradise that bedazzles everyone!
Begin your amazing tour by visiting the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage and watching the naughty elephants, yet adorable creatures bathe in the river near the orphanage where they engage in mischief, pull each other by their tails, and try to escape the hands of their caretakers in amusing ways. Awaken the adventurous soul in you by indulging in a myriad of water sports for fun and thrill in Bentota from jet skiing, banana boat ride, parasailing, paramotoring, speed boat ride, yachting, canoeing, kayaking, to boating in the mangrove forests. Conclude this tour by visiting the Red Mosque, a stunning candy-like red and white striped mosque named ‘Jami Ul-Alfar’ is the most spectacular building in your entire trip in Colombo.

All international and domestic airfare, visa fees, airport tax, or any kind of insurance cover is not a part of the package.
The above rates would vary and won't be the same on special days such as Diwali, Dussehra, Christmas and New Years.
Any personal expenses or items of personal nature will not be included in the package.

Rates may fluctuate with any change in services/hotels. The difference in the cost shall be borne by the client in case of any amendment in the package due to an increase in the number of guests, hotel change, etc., before the beginning of the trip.
The hotels are subject to their availability. In case they are not available, the travelers will be accommodated in a property of similar standard.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Colombo | Transfer to Kandy | Lake Drive with Kandyan Dance Show
days.desc: Upon arrival at Colombo Airport, you’ll be driven to Kandy. En route, stop by the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage, where you can witness rescued elephants roaming freely in their natural surroundings. Afterward, continue to Kandy and check in at your hotel. In the evening, you'll be driven around Kandy Lake, known for its picturesque views. Conclude the day with a vibrant Kandyan dance performance, offering a glimpse into Sri Lanka's rich cultural heritage through traditional music and dance.

days.title: Kandy Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, get driven for Kandy sightseeing tour, beginning with a visit to the Royal Botanical Gardens, which houses over 4,000 plant species, including orchids and palm trees. Next, take a stroll through a local spice garden. Afterward, visit the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, an important Buddhist site. Continue your tour & visit other sites like Kadugannawa Tea Factory, Huluganga Falls & the Gem Museum to discover the country’s prized gemstones. Then, get driven back to your hotel.

days.title: Transfer to Bentota | Madu Ganga Boat Safari | Kosgoda Turtle Hatchery
days.desc: After checking out, you’ll be transferred to Bentota and check in at your hotel. Later, embark on a boat ride along the scenic Madu River. As you glide through the river's calm waters, you’ll pass through lush mangrove forests, spot vibrant bird species & diverse wildlife. Then, visit the Kosgoda Turtle Hatchery, where you’ll learn about the ongoing conservation efforts to protect endangered turtle species like Hawksbill and Leatherback. Afterward, get driven back to the hotel.

days.title: Transfer to Colombo | Colombo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, check out and get transferred to Colombo. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel. Then, enjoy a city tour and visit the Gangaramaya Buddhist Temple, a prominent site of Buddhist worship. Explore Colombo Fort and see architectural marvels such as the Lotus Tower and World Trade Center. Continue your tour with a visit to the Pettah Floating Market, a vibrant marketplace where you can shop for local goods. End your day with a stroll along Galle Face Green before being driven back to the hotel.
